summary: Three commits read together by Library's reviewer. Library follow-ups (a list row with nothing interactive nested in a button: the title is the row's button and Play, Add and More are beside it; focus handed on when the A to Z strip goes while a letter has it; the sort select and Back to collections at 44px on a tablet's coarse pointer; Load More's drop after a switch that ended on the same profile pinned on both grids): every item resolved, every route into a row still reaches its handler once, no probe weakened. Navigation (the top bar leaves the search field room from 768px: the wordmark and the name give way below lg, the pill's title below xl, the shortcut hint drawn by a container query; a top-bar pass in the layout audit at eight widths): order and non-overlap hold by arithmetic, and the audit would have failed before the fix. CSS (the dead sticky-toolbar rules removed): clean. Open lows: between 1024 and 1279px the presence pill's accessible name loses the party's title; on desktop a list row's tab stop announces only the title; the coarse-pointer select height applies app-wide (harmless).
